expectations.text: Agency: at least three viable approaches exist (not just board-fight-take)
expectations.evidence: Summary: 'Board the Velvet Noose in open water, defeat Mave Sorn, and seize the Magistrate's Warding Chip.' Line 50: 'She will not surrender it through negotiation or trade. Boarding and defeating her is the only path.' Line 60: 'Mave has no interest in surrender, parley, or trade.' Explicitly rules out every alternative.

expectations.text: Causality: Mave's actions follow from her established want (supernatural confirmation to sell)
expectations.evidence: Line 59: 'She wants confirmation that the Crown's supernatural irregularity is real so she can sell that knowledge.'

expectations.text: Activity: Mave has a concrete next move if uninterrupted
expectations.evidence: Line 78: 'She will file and sell the information to a buyer whose secrecy and payment equal the value of what she has learned.'

expectations.text: Connectivity: multiple leads point to the intercept from different directions
expectations.evidence: Only 3 leads, all describing the encounter from within it (patrol records, chip record, Glass Debt sighting). No diverse routes of discovery.

expectations.text: Gravity: the chip connects to an existing PC interest or campaign thread
expectations.evidence: Connects to Wardstone split, Crown supernatural irregularity.

expectations.text: Persistence: outcomes name lasting world changes
expectations.evidence: Fallout names information broker removal, Wardstone gap detection, patrol pattern changes, buyer search.

expectations.text: Vault integrity: named entities resolve to existing wiki pages
expectations.evidence: All named entities resolve to wiki pages.

expectations.text: Quest frame sentence names incompatible wants, live pressure, and uninterrupted consequence
expectations.evidence: Line 31: 'Board the Velvet Noose, defeat Mave Sorn, and secure the Magistrate's Warding Chip' — prescriptive task, not incompatible wants.

expectations.text: Walk-away entry names what continues without the party
expectations.evidence: Line 67: 'The encounter passes without resolution. Mave continues her information trade and eventually locates a buyer.'
